text:
I partly colored my hair black. My mother didn't like it and  
reproached me to be a "subversive element". Later on she stated  
that this was due to my friends. As I see it, this all resulted  
from colouring my hair.

When I was beaten up by thieves on behalf of some friends of mine  
as they thought that I had a lot of money and would not part  
with a few coins for their drinks.

When my father phoned me to come home from my vacation, since he  
no longer had the time to look after my garden and animals.

It was the first time I met him (my boyfriend Mr.W).  It was  
during the first term Summer vacations.  We met each other while  
handing in our homework.  He invited me have a trip with him and  
we were together till 8 P.M.
When my boyfriend came back after being away for 10 days.

A bus drove over my right leg.  The event itself was not very  
frightening but when I had to wait in the emergency ward for  
three hours and then my leg began to swell, I was frightened.

Motor failure on a boat outside Gottenburg when we were in heavy   
seas and the wind was strong.  As we could not steer the boat we  
drifted towards the rocks.  We did not succeed in attracting the  
attention of any passerby until 4 hours had elapsed.
When my grandmother died - at her funeral.

I was playing with friends then I decided to splash some sand  
into a car which was moving nearby. The driver got angry and came  
to report to my parents.

For my parents anniversary, we hosted a party and we were very  
happy.

I was walking on a street alone in the afternoon when there were  
not too many people on the street.  A couple of guys were  
following me and I was ignoring them.  Suddenly one of them came  
in front of me and started using dirty language and harrassing  
me.  I got very angry and wanted to strike back at them.
Exchange of points of view with my sister on a family matter.

At a social event when none of the guests would help to serve  
food or clear tables. It was all beneath them.

One of my best friends accused me of giving up to early on  
problems. It was only a casual remark on her side, but I was  
angry and hurt.

My friend promised to take me out for a movie but he didn't turn  
up.

I cannot remember exactly such a situation. But I know that  
once I went to a very dirty lavatory and that disgusted me.

Being on view in a meat-factory. Pigs being cut open, pigs being  
suspended from nods, blood everywhere, decompsition.

I went out with my sister, her boyfriend and his friend. I did  
not like this young man. But suddenly he overcame me and kissed  
me. He was very strong so that I could not defend myself.
When I was weeding the garden I found a lizard in my hand.

When I was at school, no one thought I could pass my MCE so at  
the end of the year my name was announced on the radio that I had  
passed. I was the happiest person.
When I got to know that my father had passed away.

At the crowded conditions of living.  I always quarrel with my  
elder brother as he puts the T.V volume at a deafening level and  
I can not practise my piano lessons.  Thus I feel that my home is  
disgusting.
Every time I see a spider or a snake.

I made a long-distance call to people rather close to me and I  
thought about the sad incident that had happened to them in the  
near past; I knew that they were thinking about it too when I made  
the call.
Family member survived an operation.
Winning a game after a long time of losing.

I was appreciated by others, especially my family members and my  
friends.

With a Manager who insists on making crude innuendos pertaining  
to sex.

The situation in which I felt happiest in my life was when  
I was with the person I love for the first time.

I lived in a flat with a couple. The woman was so jealous of me,  
that she sometimes had crying fits. Eventually her husband could  
not stand that any more and wanted to kill me.

I remember the day my father died. I was 11 years old and my  
sadness was so great that until today I remember everything  
about that day, from the clothes I was wearing to the reactions of people,  
the despair of my mother and brother. It marked me a lot and was  
the greatest sadness I felt.

I felt very sad when I lost my three Kwacha at civo Stadium when  
Sam Mangwana was playing some Rumba records. That was not what I  
expected, I wanted some Disco records.

I was at home and I heard a loud sound of spitting outside the  
door.  I thought that one of my family members would step on the spit  
and bring the germs in the house.
Seeing a pornographic film when looking for a place to live.
When I was nearly beaten up by the brother of my girlfriend.

When I met a very close friend of mine after one year of  
separation.
When I was charmed by my relatives.

I saw a drunk man tottering behind his wife and insulting her  
awfully.

I was happy when at difficult times I could find support in my  
friend and my fiancT, I was happy because of their spiritual and  
moral help which gave me new power to struggle. I was happy then,  
I felt it in my soul.
Going out alone in the dark.

When I was an exploration with my friends and almost got lost in  
an unfamiliar environment.  It was getting dark and we did not  
know how to get back home.

When I learnt that a friend of mine had talked about me to  
another friend and had said wrong things about my abilities and  
attitudes.  I was very angry.

After going through much shame, I became a Christian and  
something new happened in my heart.  Joy that overflows was  
manifest in me.

When I left my boyfriend. I found another girl at his home but he  
did nothing to relieve the situation.
An old lady slipped and nobody helped her.

When I recently thought about the hard work it takes to study, and   
how one wants to try something else.  When I read a theoretical  
book in English that I did not understand.

I experienced fear when I was not prepared for the final year  
degree exams.
When a student of mine (at music) performed and played remarkably well.

When I heard about the advances an acquaintance of mine had made  
to my friends, who did not approve of them.

I was in a car accident on the way back from a weekend rowing  
regatta we'd won. 5 others were in the car. I thought I'd never  
be able to row again.

When my friends and I were camping in a weekend, and with little  
food, we met a middle age couple from a small town that invited  
us to eat in their house. Their house was small, badly built with  
old and dirty forniture and utensils. The problem was with pans,  
and dishes, and even the food.
I felt angry when my friend told me that I had stolen her money.
On the way down a ski slope which was difficult and steep.

When I was pressing figures on the curtain cloth. I had bought  
the cloth after months of hindrances.

When I slept for the first time all alone in the house where I  
live now. A man phoned me at 2.00 am. He wanted something from  
me. I was afraid.

When my girl went away for a holiday without saying good-bye to  
me.

I should have given a test lesson to get a job. I had no courage.  
I didn't make the test.

When I heard that one of my good friends, when at a party, had  
got herself involved with some very undesirable characters and  
was experimenting with drugs.
When I got my B.A degree with first class.

When I was to sit for my first entrance exam. I had fear of a  
possible failure.
Saw people spitting in public.

On embarking on University life. I came from a different city and  
did not know anybody at the Uni. I was frightened because my well  
known and loved friends, also all my security had been taken  
away.

A similar feeling I felt quite recently while travelling in a  
taxi. The driver treated me roughly and dishonestly - he chose  
the longest route, he overdrawed almost one lev more and he tried  
to be intimate with me.

When I dined with my new friends, one of them kept reminding us  
that he was superior.

My friend got married and went abroad, this made me feel sad and  
lonely.

After a busy day I went back to my hostel.  I closed the door and  
had a drink, then I read my favourite book on the bed.  Suddenly  
I felt peace and joy.

After 10 days of hard work and having suffered many changes I  
passed my last exam.

While I was pushing a court roller out of a ditch, I slipped and  
fell down and the roller rolled back towards me -down slope-It is  
a miracle that I still have my legs intact.

When I get something that seemed very hard like getting a job, a  
boyfriend, etc. A specific sutuations, was when I started to date  
a boy whom I liked for a long time.
Before an exam which I, finally did not take.

When my sister left to go home, in Sweden, after the Christmas  
Holidays.

One Saturday morning I had got ready to go out swimming with my  
friends.  Unfortunately the weather did not permit it, so we  
stayed indoors.

For a drunk man (about 20 years old) that I met one evening, and  
who behaved impudently with the girls standing by.
When my mother interfered in my life.

I and my friends got acquainted with a guy from Sofia who turned  
out to be gay, but we found that out only after 2 or 3 days.

I was very angry when my friend lost my practical's journal,  
which I needed to study for the exams.

When my father's new fiancee treats me like a child.  She does  
not trust me and constantly misunderstands me.  I get  
particularly angry when she says nasty things about my boyfriend  
with whom she works.

When Wayne and Sue (close friends) were announced our guardians  
at ther wedding.

When we got lost in Florence and the coach did not turn up until  
midnight.  I had no place to go to and there were strange reports  
at the police station.
When a skunk invaded camp.

Being invited out by a person I wished to get closer to. He  
telephoned and invited me to go out with him the next night.

The emotion came when a certain boy opened my locker without my  
knowledge.

On the road there was a dead animal with its entrails showing and  
its skull crushed.
Staying in a relative's house which was broken in before.

When my brother was born, everything went all right.  It had been  
very likely that he would have a deficiency (my sister suffers  
from Down's Syndrome) and that my mother would be in danger.

A close friend decided to stop with his study and to go back  
home.
Ran into a parking car on a bicycle.

My father recently having a heart attack - spending a few months  
in hospital.
Passing an exam I did not expect to pass.
When I failed an exam.

I was sitting in the bus and a man with a very unpleasant  
smell came and sat next to me, to top it all he smoked  
continously.

When I was accused of having impregnated someone's daughter, it  
was the girl's cousin who had done it.

After sitting for the Standard 8 Exams for the second time in  
1979, I had great joy when I heard that I was successful in the  
Examination when the results were out.

When my last year's second semester results came through - I was  
ecstatic.

I was most disgusted when I had to make a nagging three day  
journey recently from Calcutta to Bombay.  It was very boring and  
tiring.

When I saw a film in which the man suffered from an illness and     
his skin came peeling off.
Recently I happened to remain alone for a long time.

I lead a rather secure life.  The only thing I can remember is a  
song from the nineteenth century which is against alcohol.  Both  
the melody and the word (although naive) effected my emotions.

The acts of brutal violence in generally disgusts me. Fights,  
phisical aggrssion, etc.

My young brother took my wristwatch in my abscence and sold it to  
his friend at a cheaper price.

When I tried to explain to my child as to why there were  
magazines wiith naked girls on them at the kiosk.

I had this feeling when I met a girl, not that she was dirty but  
she was to "fresh", dump and childish.
When I had my four children.

When I found out that the seat in the coach that I had booked had  
been sold to somebody else.

Losing my job that I had for 4 summers. I took it personally and  
cried for 6 hours off and on. I wanted to hide away and did for a  
few days.

About my girlfriend's sister who is a viper as I discovered some  
time ago.

The time I lost a badminton match, that I should have won at the  
Zambia closed badminton championships.

It was spring and the ice was melting.  I was far out on a jetty and I poked the ice with a long branch to try and break it.
 The branch went through the ice and I fell in, the water closed  
in over my head.

I had been away from home for a long time and when I came home I  
was delighted.  It was wonderful to see familiar, dear people and  
I was rejoycing in advance.  I had been feeling very lonely.

Getting a terrible exam mark, which I couldn't understand the  
reason for, and trying to see a lecturer or tutor, but being  
given the runaround.

I got angry when I learned how short a time we had to prepare for  
the term examinations.

When my parents separated temporarily and I was left behind with  
my father.  As I loved my mother I wanted to go with her.
I like someone who does not like me and was rude to me.
When I was admitted to the University.
I met my best friend's husband with a prostitute.
When I happen to witness some sadistic acts.

The thought that I'll never sit at the school desk again, caused  
a deep grief at the end of my eleventh form.

When I watched TV and saw a performance of "Prince" (a popidol).  
Disgusting he'd better be a stallion.

I tried my level best to care for my client, I took an  
appointment with a doctor and before meeting the doctor he  
expired - a poor small boy from Uttar Pradesh.

When high level results were declared, I found my candidature  
number.  I was very happy as I had not expected it.  As I had been   
injured before the examination and I had performed poorly.

One summer when I was camping with friends they devised and  
elaborate plan to scare me by having our camp attecked by a wild  
animal (one of them) and then convincing the campground was  
the home of a satanic organization.

My father had an operation which lasted for hours.  We were all  
very worried but it was successful.

I read a book whose plot and expressions were obscene and in very  
bad taste.

When an argument with a friend of mine over our behaviour towards  
another friend turned into a quarrel.   I lost my temper and nearly  
knocked him out.
It happened that I was alone - with no contacts with friends.

During an argument between friends, one of them accused me of  
taking advantage of some other friends who usually come to the  
university in my car, saying that I ask them too much money for  
the petrol.

My room-mate locked up our room without specifying where I would  
find the keys.  I had to spend several hours in my other friend's  
room.

A party with no worries (i.e. no tests homework etc.) many  
friends were present and good music.
Saw a mate bribing the leader.

When my boyfriend and I went out for a dinner and subsequently  
went to his family. We had a very nice evening.

We had fixed time for practice as we had to participate in the  
inter-department song contest.  I arrived and found that there  
was nobody there.  When I went to the canteen I found them eating  
lunch.  I was so angry that I aired my greviances to one of them  
and then left.

I met my present boyfriend on a boat trip to England.  We had  
said that we would call each other when we got back to Sweden (we  
were not going to the same town in England).  As soon as I walked  
in he called from England as he could not wait till he came  
home.

I received money from my father at a time when I was completely  
broken.

When I saw parents punishing their little child for something he  
had not done.  In my opinion, even if he had done it he should  
not have been punished for it.

I felt it on the same occasion when I felt sadness which finally  
grew into anger.

Finding out that my health condition may be against my attending  
university lectures.
After shouting at a friend.

Housesitting and hearing the alarm go off. I knew someone had to  
be breaking in. I called the police and was panicking while on  
the phone. It was awful. It turns out that I stepped on the  
hidden alarm without prior knowledge of its existance.
Having my luggage checked at Customs.

When I was a student at the Institute doing my M.Phil degree, one  
of my professors called me before the convocation and told me  
"You have got the gold-medal (first rank) in the university and  
tomorrow you will be on T.V".

I live with my sister now and sometimes she angers me especially  
when she thinks I don't keep the apt. clean enough.

For not having succeded in getting the job as a translator that I  
wanted.

At a certain situation I felt myself neglected and undeservedly  
harmed.

When I made up with a girl-friend of mine after having been on  
unfriendly terms with her (my fault).  I cried with joy that  
evening.

For the loss of a close friend or relative, but you feel grief  
when you are away from home, too.

When realizing that my girlfriend and myself in fact had started  
the process of breaking up.
Had a letter from my father (usually he does not write to me).

With the girl whom I may be loved truly. When she refused to come  
with me to an occasion (she was from another town).

When we were in high school a few guys sometimes provoked a  
friend of mine.  They called her a pig and then grunted.  This  
irritated most of the girls.  Once, one of the girls got angry at  
my friend and said something nasty and this made me terribly  
angry.
I did not quite succeed in breast feeding my baby.
When my mother died.

When I gave birth to my son and saw that he was alive and that I  
had managed it well.  He was born a month too early with a  
malfunctioning lung.  This happened a year ago.

When I was very young, one day, I was in the street with my  
father and brother.   While my father was talking to some  
friends, I saw a dog and began to pat it.  My father told me  
sharply to stop doing it because the dog had mange.  Then my  
brother told me that I would die and I could not stop crying  
after this.

I had met someone and we became good friends. Our relationship  
grew closer and now he is my boyfriend. I felt joy when I found  
out how he felt about me.

My main disgust is against codfish because I detest even the  
smell of it.

When my parents behave very "witty" towards me, they make insipid  
jokes about which they laugh. Or my mother who treats me like a  
little child.

When I entered a brothel and saw two sailors with a young  
prostitute who was not older than 18.
When my brother (5th in the family) passed away.

When I was accepted as a student of Psychology here at  
Gutttenburg.
If a guy one is not interested in makes advances.

My roommate leaving my drawers in a mess after plowing thourgh  
them looking for something.

When I talked with a teacher yesterday who, to say the least, was  
rude and unwise and had irrelevant opinions about a friend.
I'd just got the top mark in an exam.

I worked at a lawyer's office during Summer and I got a very  
good reference from him.

On a trip to Santander a child sitting beside me fell ill and  
started to vomit, seeing this made me feel very bad.
When I accepted Jesus Christ as my personal saviour.

A nightmare.  I was dreaming about bloodsuckers, which I tried to  
shake off from my body, they are everywhere, they get glued, they  
suck.  And there are a lot of them.  I panic.

When I finished a relation after four years, leading to much  
sorrow for the other one and myself ("although it was the best  
solution").

Realizing that a friend had been talked into signing a certain  
contract.

Some time ago I was disgusted with the "cleanness" of the  
refectory of our institute.

I feared that I was pregnant.  It was not planned and I would  
have been compelled to have an abortion, which I would not have  
liked at all.  Fortunately, after a week's anxiety, I got to know  
that I was not pregnant.
When a close friend drowned in the American River.
When the gear broke on my car.

When my husband lied to me, tricked me and when I had to leave my  
home.
I saw a septic, smelling wound.

This issue worried me rather than saddening me.  In mid September  
I went to Guanggho alone.  I was looking for an accomodation in  
the evening and after having walked 2 or 3 miles I still could not  
find anything.  What could I do?  I was not worried about  
sleeping on the streets but because of some procedural problems.   
I finally found a place to sleep at 8 o'clock.

I was waiting to receive the participation on the profits and did  
not receive it.

Stopped at lights in Mangere late one Friday night on way home  
from work. Alone in car when someone came up behind the car and  
started banging and shaking it. Light was red and had nowhere to  
go until light changed. When green I took off.

At about midnight I had to go by bike through Graz alone. On the  
whole it was a distance of several kilometers. A car followed me  
through the streets. Only when I went into a one-way street the  
car disappeared. The rest of my way home I was very afraid.

I lived alone in a repulsive area in the city of Rotterdam. I was  
annoyed, heard a lot of Burglary and assaults. Especially in the evening  
and the night I frequently felt anxious.
I found myself a place after looking for one for a long time.
When my mother had a nervous illness.

I felt disgusted when a certain lady spoke words of sarcasm when  
I was trying to propose to her.
I was not chosen for the All English class.

When I heard on the radio that the football match in Belgium had  
ended in a catastrophe, and several people had died.  I could not  
 understand how normal people could behave in such a way.
When my beloved grandfather died.

My sister had to undergo a very complicated operation, her  
eyesight was at stake.

The day I was to receive my gold-medal for the M.A, my  
grandmother, who I loved very much, died after an illness.  She   
died a few hours before the convocation.  While I was  
attending the convocation I had to control my grief as she would  
not have liked me to miss it.  It was a day she had been waiting  
for, but did not get to see.

When the grandmother of my friend died in a hospital. My friend  
was crying and I was sad, too.

During a trivial (friendly) discussion, one of the participants  
made an intervention which made me feel uncomfortable.

I received the message that I'd been accepted at the school where I  
really wanted to go.

After being depressed because of a very bad relationship, my  
first love called me and told me that he would always care for me  
no matter what I did.

I felt a physical fear, if I can call it this way, today, in the bus where  
I was sitting on the first seat. While turning the driver didn't  
see the tram which was making a dash towards us (coming from the  
side I was), and whose driver intended to cross in yellow  
light.

I felt anger against a colleague of mine during a rehearsal in  
acting. He hadn't learnt the text of an opera act in the course of  
several months and thus making difficulties for the rest of my  
colleagues.

When  first came to CAL I went to a rally on Sproul and I later  
learned that the rally was conducted by the Moonie cult. They  
were taking pictures at the rally, so I was afraid that they  
would circulate the pictures and then kidnap people. I did not  
know how the cult worked. I was scared.
When I got a small present form a person I like very much.

My older sister used to pick on my brothers and sisters all of  
whom were younger than her. On one occasion my brother did  
something my sister didn't like. A full-scale battle began.

Having been unjustly punished, I feel disgust towards the person  
responsible.

When I felt powerless to help the poor or when I don't know how  
to.

A rainy day, I was cycling downhill and a car door suddenly  
opened and while trying to avoid it the back wheels of my bike  
got caught in the tram tracks.  I somersaulted but had no  
injuries.

When an unpleasant person tried to make friends with me.  A  
subtle, small, insignificant, grey being whose helplessness and  
neutrality evoked the feeling of disgust in me.
The death of a close friend.

When I found out that my sister had been playing with my  
confidential things which she had taken from my hand-bag.

When I was very young and we moved as a family to Auckland from  
Wellington, this meant new school and friends (etc.).

The patient whom I expected to get well suddenly passed away  
after he showed had his meals.

The repression of rioting and non-rioting "Blacks" in South  
Africa by the police of that "Democracy".

For a few days I felt very miserable, distressed and listless,  
with crying fits. When this was over I felt very happy, although  
there was no special reason.

When I dived among sharks and the brightly coloured fish on the  
outer reef of Tvavni, Fidgi.
I saw some images of a decapitation in a horror film.

Upon moving away from home for the first time to a different  
city, I felt no longer "under the wing" of my parents even though  
they would always be there to help me. I felt a sense of loss, I  
was now all alone in the world, responsible for my own actions.

When I heard that I was not to be provided with another pair of  
medical uniform.

One day I was in the countryside with several friends, and we  
began to eat figs, after we were all full we noticed that all the  
figs were full of worms.
When I was travelling at night.

My mother and her friends were speaking badly about my father  
when they were separated, and my brothers and sisters and myself  
were allowed to listen.

When I was going to bring back my girlfriend to LA to meet my  
parents.

Two years ago my best friend died in an accident, just a day  
before my birthray.  We were very close to each other and I felt  
very sad at loosing a close friend.

When I was the first to arrive at the scene after an accident,  
and found that a close school friend had been killed.

I was very joyful when I heard that I had passed the standard 8  
exams. The day I heard the news was the day I celebrated my  
birthday.

When there was a fight at home and my father threatened to throw  
a chair on my brother.

When bicycling along, a courier van started to tail me very close  
- I sped up and moved over and he just did the same. I reacted  
violently, much physical responding in the dangerous situation.

A car came very close to hitting me whilst I was crossing the  
street.

Two boys whom I know were telling me, in an indecent manner, how  
they had teased a young and shy girl I know.  They had despised  
her conviction, scorned and touched her.  I got very angry and  
did not try to conceal it and gave it back to them.
A friend who was 22 years old died.

No very strong such emotion. Treatment of my sister by her  
dancing instructor - he is a "user", i.e., takes advantage of her  
good nature.

I felt angry when I heard that my sister had failed the  
Examinations which we hoped she was going to pass with  
distinctions.
Aticle published.

Doctors ignored relative who complained about pain, and is now  
dying of cancer.

I was with my girlfriend when some guys that I don't like made  
fuss at my girl.

I was in about Grade 7, I came home from school one day and was told  
that my mother had skin cancer and would have to go to the hospital  
straight away.

When people without my permission pry in my belongings and take  
things out of it.

When I heard that I had been selected fot the first year at the  
university of Zambia.  This was after my form five at Chikola  
secondary school.

After having considered it for hours I was able to overcome my  
scruples and to call a friend with whom I had fallen in love. I  
realized that my decision was right - and was very glad.

After a meeting ended we started talking about when we would  
have the next discussion ( I had many tests the coming week and  
could not have a meeting in between, I thought that they would  
understand this as they had always done).  They did not  
understand my problem and thought that I should not have so many  
other activities.  Their reaction made me burst into tears.

I felt disgusted when I was not given money for lunch at school  
by my father as a punishment for beating my little brother.
When I told my girlfriend a joke openly and frankly.

On Christmas day a drunk man came to our house without a shirt  
on, he dansed, spoke nonsense and behaved stupidly.

When I am with friends and I do what pleases me this often  
happenes.
The price I was charged for work on my car.
I was going away, leaving a dear person behind.

When I realized that I could not communicate properly with my  
closest friend.

When I received my U.E. accredited as I was totally unexpecting  
it and I was so happy.
On seeing a scene of an accident in a magazine.

It was on 9th January 1983 when I received a message from home  
telling me that my father passed away on the previous day with a  
history of cancer of the oesophagus. This time I was doing my  
third year of my Secondary School.

[ During a certain period, I felt successful and extremely satisfied.    
When I found that any tasks or decisions that I had made were better   
than expected.]

A very close friend from Victoria visited me over the holidays.  
Having enjoyed his company immensely over 10 short days, I was  
overwhelmed by sadness when he left to return to Victoria.
I saw a report on T.V news on apartheid in South Africa.
When someone makes advances that one does not want.
Hear a very nice joke made by a friend.

When I have to go in for an exam and the examinor is a person

When I heard a rumour that the 1st year exam results were out. I  
had fear that I might be one of the failures.

I felt sad when a thief stole all the clothes from my friend's  
cupboard at school (boarding).

My husband suddenly fell ill seriously and during the medical  
examinations we did not know what would follow.
When the girl I loved turned me down.

I did a solo flight from Ardmore to Kaikohe before I got my pilot  
licence. I can remember it was gorgeous day and I was on a  
natural high, cruising up the coast with my maps and compasses  
and gear. Other pilots had seen me off and wished me good luck  
and it was a real adventure.

At night when I was alone at home (all the family members usually  
get together at that time) someone knocked vigorously on the  
door.

I went singing with a group of young people on January 6th (The  
three Magi), a local custom called "star singing". One of the girls, my  
girlfriend, broke the star. Being the accompanying person, I felt very  
angry thinking of the consequences.
When I came back from my holidays.

A close acquaintance of the family died of lung cancer.   
Although it was expected, I still felt depressed.
Finding out some people had been talking about me at my back.

One day my friend told me that she had heard that I was moving  
about with her boyfriend. I was disgusted with the news.

When my mother decided to clean out my room and throw out what  
she thought was junk, without my knowing about it, so I returned  
home to find half my stuff gone.

When some people, including me, are treated in a way which  
equates them to an animal or a thing.
At having an argument with a stranger, in the street.
I was told to do something I did not want to do.

When I was eight years old my father was run over by a car. When  
I saw his body I was sad beyond words.

One day during our clinical practices, we had a very ill patient.  
Unfortunately the patient passed away. I had seen him dying and  
it was the first experience. During the night I became afraid  
fearing the dead body.

When I was deputy manager during the Summer, certain deputies  
took liberties, more than what was normal.

When I was informed that a short story I had written had been  
accepted for publication.

When after a storm in the country, I left my shelter and saw a  
big, fat, slimy green toad by my side.

I had an appointment downtown, and the person in question was  
half an hour late.

"Boy, you have been admitted to the medicine school and your  
uncle is coming back fron Canada next week," my father told me  
and it was a happy moment.
Got a present from my friend for my birthday.

After joining my M.A in Social Sciences, I appeared for the first  
semester exam.  I failed one of the exams, and when I looked at  
my results I felt disgusted and then I got angry.

When a close friend took leave of me, because she went to Israel  
for one year.
A dirty person, smelling bad and unknown laying on me.

When I almost ran over a small boy who suddenly was in front of  
my car.

Some students whose English is worse than mine can go to your  
lectures (English lectures).

I went to the school library and asked for a book, but the  
librarian told me that there wasn't such. However when an other  
colleague asked for it she gave it to him.

I went to see a movie and I went with a friend, it was really  
frightening and it made me stop and think about the world around  
me and what it is really like out there. I was frightened all  
that night.

I received a phone call from a high school friend whose younger  
sister studied with me at the University and gave me a lift every  
moning. She was going to get married to a guy whom I knew too and  
who had died when he fell from a building, I was afraid to lose  
somebody since I had already lost a brother in an accident.
Same situation as before - having my car stolen.

I deliberately avoided a person who I wanted to hurt, and who  
wanted to talk to me.
When I went to my first dental appointment.

When I was doing my last year at Secondary School I was robbed of  
my clothes, wristwatch and my pair of shoes. After investigations  
it was found that all the things were stolen by one of the boys  
in our hostel.

When a close relative of mine passed away, it was the first time  
that someone so close to me had died.

When my parents-in-law scolded me, without any reason, in front of the  
other members of my family for the first time.  They had called  
me from my room where I had been studying for my exams.

When I was in form 3, my aunts lied to my daddy telling him that  
I had told them that I was pregnant.  My daddy  told my mother  
and she asked me if it was true.  I was very angry with my aunts.

When I began to date a boy with whom I am till now. This was 16  
months ago.

Disgust with myself for consistently making foolish errors in  
communicating with others (asking for 1/2 Kg of nuts when I only  
wanted 50 g).
My old friend visited me in the university.

My first day to work in hospital, when I was dressing wounds I  
was disgusted when I came across one wound with a very bad smell.
I was admitted to the University and a niece was born to me.

I felt some disgust for my boyfriend for a time, after he had  
left me.
Someone called me a disgusting nickname.

When I had a psychical crisis, I met a girl, who told me that she  
had had almost the same problems and how she had finally overcome  
them.

On TV I saw a report about church in Amerika. A priest was shown  
who was performing miracles in front of the camera - I felt  
disgusted.

When the N.Z. rugby union announced that they would proceed with  
a rugby tour of South Africa.
Loneliness, being uncertain of myself in the Autumn.

When I meet old past pupils of mine - and find they are all doing  
well - I feel joy. Yesterday I met a young woman (20 yrs) I'd  
taught her at 6 yrs, then at 12 yrs and hadn't seen her for last  
3-4 yrs; she was no longer a waitress but a meter maid for  
Council.

When a good friend of mine behaved in a very cool manner to me  
for a very long time.
In the dark an unreal figure formed by a shadow.

Walking home at night after university - part of the way, there  
are ano lights and I am walking down a thoroughfare with the  
thouth of no one hearing me if I have to scream.
When my grandmother died.

When our government decided to withdraw student allowances as it  
was one of the conditions imposed by the IMF.

When I went to the clinic for a medical check-up and saw the way  
the lecturer was conducting the lecture and the kind of responses  
he got from the patients.

My friend took me to Civo Stadium to watch and listen to the  
music of the International singer Sam Mangwana. I had no hope of  
going there since I had no money so he gave me the money for  
admission.

I felt fear when once I was asleep and dreamed that I was dying  
asfixiated by a cardiac attack, I was afraid and woke up  
desperate. Altough I wasn't afraid of death I was afraid.

I was living in rooms in a very lonely, quiet neigbourhood.  
During the night it was very silent and this frightened me. The  
fact of being alone in that house frightened me.
Seeing a person panhandling money on Telegraph.
Always when I am well succeded.

My father began to say incoherant things concerning my brother's and  
my own behaviour towards him.  His biased (authoritarian) and  
ridiculous point of view made us angry.

When I heard that a good friend, who had been abroad for a long  
time, would come and see me.
The event which got me angry got also an aversion in me.

Last year I had a friend visiting me for several days. The only  
thing he did was sleeping, drinking, taking pills and thinking  
only about himself.

When the Real Madrid football team lost against the inter in the  
U.E.F.A cup.
I had to give up my love, because it did not work out well.

In 1960,  I was going to a school which was near my village and I  
met a lion on the way, which disappeared suddenly.

At one point in a relationship, my boyfriend was seeing an old  
flame more than me. At our confrontation tears were shed.

I watched a very terrfying film in LT2.  This film really pushed  
my heart out of my body and I was forced to go out before the  
second reel ended.

When my father banned me from going to his sister's home due to  
some misunderstanding between the two.

The comrade staying next doors insulted me for what he called   
the misuse of his iron.  He called me stupid, self centered etc.   
I wanted to punch him but instead went for a walk to the mining  
school to cool off.
When I gave birth to a healthy boy.

When I spoke to my daughter and wished her luck for the  
examinations she was about to take.

When I entered the dissecting room for the anatomy class and saw  
several dead bodies lying on the benches.

When my boyfriend came form Rumphi to Lilongwe for a visit I was  
very happy to see him and couldn't believe it was him with me.

When I opted for my research field, for them the percentage of  
marks was more important than my knowledge.

Right now I volunteer at a hospital. Yesterday, Halloween, I  
dressed up as a doctor and went to work. The volunteer  
coordinator told me after my shift that it was dangerous to have  
done what I did.

When a boy who was drunk came into my room and misbehaved in the  
presence of my boyfriend.

When I was younger I often saw my father come home drunk (he had  
big problems at that time). Once he woke me up in the middle of  
the night and shouted at me.

I thought that someone was angry with me but, by hindsight, that  
didn't appear to be the case, he even liked me.
Disgust with drunk people.

When my relatives and I were in a car going slowly on a frozen  
road.
A typical family argument.

My younger brother destroyed and gave away some of the books that  
I had intended to keep for as long as possible.
After the fact that made me ashamed I felt sadness.

I felt disgusted when my appointment to meet the E.N.T.  
specialist had been turned down. The specialist came from U.K.  
and went the same day and we do not have one.
When I worked at the life-saving sevice and saw the first exitus.

I saw someone that I thought I knew repeatedly drunk. I do not  
like to be around alcoholics.

While in the army, I was treated unfairly by my superiors.  I was  
held responsible for a deed of which I was innocent.
A close friend of mine had not contacted me for a long time.

When I heard that there is teasing and bulling at Secondary  
School.

When I wanted to go into a house, there was suddenly a big dog  
standing beside me. It was hardly moving, but I did not know how  
it would react later on.

I felt the above condition when I took my brother's bicycle to a  
market and unfortunately the bicycle was stolen and I didn't know  
how I could tell the owner about the stolen bicycle.

When I was notified that I had been accepted as a Psychology  
student.
[ When some people act very important in any situation.]
Watching a horror film.
A certain night during initiation.

It was the first time that I gave a birthday present to my friend.  
  She wrote me a letter as she is my girlfriend.  The content of  
the letter was so sweet that it made me feel very happy.

I reached the bus stop and realized that I had forgotten my bus  
pass.

The house was on fire, and I was saved by the dog. I am afraid of  
the fire, verging on panic.
My good friend misunderstood me.
Helping older people on the toilet.
When one is unjustly accused of something one has not done.

The thought of having to read a boring book of 400 pages in  
English.

I was walking along the passage to my room (very near the anatomy  
laboratory) and I heard something and felt that there was some  
thing behind me.  I looked back and there was no one.  I started  
imagining that maybe it was a corpse.

Feeling unable to preserve one's ideas and ambitions as innocent  
as they are when you are young.

After I was thrown out of a car in an accident, this resulted in  
a fracture.

It was in March 1985 when one of my fellow students borrowed my  
wristwatch and after sometime he broke a glass of that watch I  
got angry when he was telling me but the anger didn't take long  
to fade.

When my friend told me that he would come and meet me in a  
moment.
When I found out that I can travel with my best friend.
When I try to get closer at a person and she misinterpreted me.

My cat was sick and I had to take him to the vet to be put down -  
no one else there to do it.

I felt happy at the settlement of our marriage, even though we  
are from different socio-linguistic backgrounds our parents  
agreed to the wedding without any conflict or discussion.  We had   
thought that they would object to the wedding but it did not happen.
Finding a hair in the soup.

When I think that I will probably never have a genuine contact  
with my parents.

When a boy, who was drunk, insulted me in front of a crowd.  I  
was stopped from punching him for it.

I was filled with joy when I heard that I had passed my Secondary  
school leaving certificate exam.
A saturday night a bus full of drunken people.

When I knew that a person that I liked very much didn't react the  
way I would like to, even that I knew about his feelings for me.

Every time I meet a certain person. We cannot get on well  
together, we dislike each other.
I made dinner for some friends and they appreciated it very much.

One night, at a friend's place I realized that I had everything I  
most wished, around me.
Won a prize for effort.

The sadness came to me when I heard that my girlfriend whom I  
loved so much got married to another man before a rebuff from  
her.
I felt very angry after one driver had run over my beloved niece.

Walking at friday night through Nijmegen, going to a pub or a  
disco.
When friends try to put me down or hurt me.

I had had a farewell party at the place where I had been working  
for a year.  That night I could not fall off to sleep.  I was sad  
thinking that I would not see my nice fellow workers again.

My illness a few years back.  I was sevely down with malaria and  
asthma, I had lost my health, charm and cheerfulness completely.

I was walking alone along the place where people fear that there  
are always thieves there and the people who kill their friends  
during the night two months ago.

My boy-friend came home late one night without having told me  
about it before.

While swimming, I hit my head at the bottom of the pool and  
required stitches. I later learned that the consequences could  
have been much more severe and that terrified me.

My paternal grandmother had died. We weren't close but she was  
blood. I didn't cry but I was sad, partly due to her death and  
partly I think, due to the fact that I couldn't/didn't cry.

A quarrel was followed by the decision of leaving a person close  
to me. Several days later my regret was great. I was beside  
myself. Quite unexpectedly he came and the conflict was calmly  
solved. I was glad at the possibility to be with him.

In Punjab, when in the name of religion people killed each other  
during the agitation.
Day I received my T.E. score and acceptance into my chosen course.

I met again a very good friend after a year and realized that  
there had grown a certain distance between us.
Being told that I am a stupid person.

After my shoulder operation, I woke up in the hospital room  
alone. I was in pain and was still under heavy medications. I  
could not find my parents.

I had some sort of a stomach virus last week and  I vomited in  
college in the morning, then in the cake shop, three times during  
the trip home and again when I got home.

My elder brother often criticizes my mother's cooking.  Once he  
did it very impolitely and lost his temper.  This made all of us  
very sad.  I was very angry and I scolded him.  He asked me not  
to interfere with what was his buisness.
Being mistreated by other people.

I once saw a programme on TV describing how certain wild life  
films were made and was disgusted by the treatment of certain  
animals in this particular programme of the polar bear.

I was given a gift by my sister. There were many pleasant things  
in this parcel.
Before important sports events.

Brother continually interupting while I was talking on the  
telephone.
When I learnt that I was selected for form I.

Day before yesterday my mother bought me a new pair of shoes,  
without my having asked for them.  She told me that when she saw  
the pair of shoes she felt like buying them for me.  I really  
liked the shoes and they made me feel that my mother cares for  
me.

My mother read a letter that a friend of mine had written to me  
telling me how she had got drunk the last time.

When an acquaintance (he was drunk) of my room-mate vomitted on the kitchen  
carpet.  It was past mid-night and my room-mate had just moved in,  
this acquaintance had helped her move in.

When a so-called friend let me down, when she promised to tell me  
when a certain concert was occurring, and that she'd get me  
tickets. I was really looking forward to it. She did nothing,  
just told me out of the blue one day what a fantastic concert it  
was going to be.

My close friend and I applied to TISS for admission last year,  
unfortunately he failed to get admission.  We had done our graduation  
together and are quite involved with each other, so we had wanted  
to do our Masters degree together.  However, it did not work out  
as we had expected it to and this saddened me.
Assaulted by drunken neighbour.

I felt dusgust with a self-iterested person who ruined the life  
of another by means of utterly unfair methods.

I bet that I would jump down from a window. I was sure that I  
would jump but before I did it I rather felt fear.
When I come home late at night.

When I failed the grade 7 twice and only passed it the third  
time.
A friend started to shout at me. He called me an old frump.

For the girl who halped me go on living and made me happy - when  
I don't see her even for two or three days.
When my grandparents moved to another part of the town.
Walking in the dark I saw something strange.
Deception from a person I loved very much.
When one of my friends started misbehaving.

I was very sad when I heard that my uncle had passed away  
untimely at home.

When I saw a man hitting a child of 2 years without any consideration,

Being in a Malaysian city with my girlfriend coming out of a  
picture theatre - seeing her rush up to a taxi that a very old  
sick man was trying to get to. Seeing her take over the taxi.

I had not eaten anything for 2 days to be able to pay the fine  
for my fiancT. But he stayed in another town and spent one  
thousand shillings in the restaurant during the same time.

Finding out that some students are getting good reports they do  
not deserve.

A relationship in which I had put my trust, broke up.  I was sad  
when I realized how easy it is to forget something that one had  
once regarded as great and significant.
When I passed the grade 7 exam.

I was approaching my exam time and my books got stolen.  I was in  
a panic as I thought that I would not do well enough to be  
considered for the economics quota.  I cried a lot but that did  
not help and as the exam day came near a strange fear gripped me.

I felt sad with the two situations I described before. The cat  
and the school. Sadness was intermingled with the other feelings.

Some foreign students playing loud music before the biology  
examn.

I bought a new bed for my apt. and it squeaks when you move on  
it. I tried to fix it but could not.

When I received my TE Score and my acceptance from University -  
it had been a goal since I left the bank a year earlier.

One of my good friends had to migrate to America.  Our friendship  
had developed quite well and it was a pity as our friendship would  
fade.

My parents did not approve my choice of a boyfriend (now an  
ex-boyfriend).  He happened to be 13 years older than me and he

I had a very good friend (boy) and I thought I could rely on him  
but he behaved badly with a girl who used to trust us completely.

When I read the newspaper that morning I found my candidature  
number on the admission list of the Chinese university.  I was  
satisfied and happy and the cumulative anxiety disappeared.  I  
only wanted to cry out that I had succeeded.
A close friend died.

I was in a train when a woman started talking loudly and  
attracting everybody's attention.  The worst thing was that she  
was discussing something, about which she knew nothing, with another person.

I was very pleased and happy when my older sister came home from  
living somewhere out of town and I hadn't seen her for months. We  
are very close sisters.

When I saw several people washing their car with water from a  
drain.
When they changed my office to another room without my agreement.
Spit and vomit.
An inter-college basket-ball match.
A rich man expressing disgust towards an alcoholic.

When during Winter the water pipes froze and we did not have any  
water for two days.

I was about to begin a journey in a car with an acquaintance of  
mine.

A fear from the loss of a close friend as a result of his  
behavior.

Father said: If you are pregnant, you will have to procure  
abortion. I was filled with disgust against my father.
Having quarreled with a boyfriend, he threatened to leave me.
When a friend died.

When I found out that I could not go to the concert (after buying  
the tickets) because of a biology test which occurred the morning  
after.
When I got the loan for my studies.

On my birthday, an old friend of mine sent me a card. I had not  
met him for a year and I was very glad that he had thought of me.
When I heard the news of my grandfather's sudden death.

I felt very angry when a mishanga seller robbed me of the  
transport money I had to go to school.

A drunkard fell, started bleeding and wet himself.  Disgust that

I was at the table at a French friend's house.  They served me a

Reading about executions and massacres which happened during

When I am alone in a room with no contact with anyone -  
loneliness drains me.

The shooting started and we all lay down to protect ourselves

Feira, during the Zambia army patrols in the Rhodesia war.

I was very happy when I passed and went to form I.  It was a

I studied medicine for several semesters and at that time I  
developed a great fear of examinations. I was most afraid of my

dissecting. I was able to hear everything and was waiting with  
fear until it was my turn.

Coming to this lecture and listen to you talking about feelings,  
I am so happy that foreigners have the same feelings as Chinese.
When I was successful at my work I was full of joy.

When I was travelling home by bus and suddenly the bus hit and  
the bus leaned against a wall.
My roommate messing up our room.

I was at the seaside and my brother disappeared for a couple of  
hours.
Doing this pointless questionnaire.
Every time I went home with my school report.
When I failed my Standard 8 Examination for the first time.

When I was ten I got shut in the school with a friend.  I had to

Tonight in bed when I realised how bad my relationship with my  
friend was.
My teacher's death.
My roommate's lack of consideration of me.
I could not do the questions on my math midterm.
Got a big fish in fishing.

I once got a phone call stating "one of your friend is in jail,  
please come and see him".  When I went to the jail and saw him, I

I told my friend something confidential which was supposed to

me to tell her about it.  I was very angry with my friend as I  
had trusted her.
Getting back with my boyfriend after a year away - apart.

Last year when I worked during the Summer holidays and studied  
at the same time for an examination I had to repeat; my boyfriend  
went to Greece for a holiday for a month.

When I heard that I had got the best result in school and would  
be definately selected to the university of Zambia.

A person I know who tells lies and so pretending to be better  
than she is.

A certain friend tried to push me off a seat in a very violent

something.

One Saturday afternoon, I deliberately dressed up nicely (I had  
been in a bad mood of late).  I hoped to go for a walk in the  
soft sunlight to try and uplift my spirits.  When I was having  
lunch in the canteen, two of my male classmates asked me as to  
why I was dressed so nicely (they had seldom joked with me

look very nice if we wore them together.

I felt angry when I was told that I had not been selected to go  
to the University.

When I came again in contact with a girl I liked very much. And

When my son returned from mountaineering - healthy in body and  
soul.

was no doctor or compounder near by and for a few hours -8 A.M to

or  milk.  There was no movement in her body and I felt really

When the car I was driving skidded on an icy road and landed in    
a ditch with one side against a rock.

In a tram, the ticket seller was commanding, taking the role of a  
leader, trying to emphasize her non-existent authority with undue  
strictness towards a good-humoured drunk who could not find his  
ticket at once.
During a fight with my best friend.

When I saw a lady putting on a pair of trousers, I felt it was a

I was sleeping nicely until in the middle of the night when I became

nonsens reason.

I made an appointment with a friend to drink coffee togehter.

late.

I am disgusted with the fact that bad singers play at the opera  
(and not only there) only because they are protegTs or lovers of  
an important felow while at the same time some young and able  
singers work in a quite different field of life.

When I saw that I had passed the university entrance exam.  It  
made me forget all my problems.

Stopped at a Fast Food shop with friends and a few locals wanted  
to fight us for no apparent reason. They hit and picked on one of  
my friends.
Robbery mentioned under sadness.

When people are eating unsavoury (smacking, belching, speaking  
with food in their mouth, etc.).

I was in a train where a fight occurred. One person who was there  
opened his handbag and took out a gun, another who fought too  
looked among his things for a weapon to fight.
When I was accused of neglecting work for the wrong reasons.

When I realized that I was far behind the others in the language  
course and I could no longer catch up with the others.

I was in the library of medical psychology and walked into the  
wrong direction. A man who came out of a room threated me very  
denigrating and I became very angry in a resisting manner.

A good friend quitted me after he had behaved in a strange  
manner.
When I had to come back from my village last Christmas.

While he was drunk, my life partner tried to hit me.  I felt  
scared and fled to the bathroom.

At the tender age of eleven a friend and I left a party and  
proceeded to walk through dark and secluded streets of a bad  
neighborhood to find a telephone (recent spate of Horror Movie  
watching had occurred).

A female friend was violently ill on the return journey from a  
wedding reception we attended. Getting her out of the car when  
home took quite a while.

I'm afraid of driving on the special seat of a mororcycle, mainly  
with certain colleagues who by exces of self-confidence drive  
beyond limits or measure in the traffic and the main victim is  
always the person who sits behind the driver.
When boyfriend could not stand up to his mother or for himself.

When a friend carelessly broke and object in my parent's house  
and did not apologize, or pay, or anything.
In a disco, there was a dirty little chap who punched my bottom.
Finding out that China is still backward in science.
When I saw a dog which had been knocked down by a car.

It was when I discovered that my boyfriend had another girl. I  
discovered it through a letter he wrote to the girl when he was  
away. When I asked him he accepted it.

When my boyfriend told me that it would be difficult for him to  
marry me.

I was studying in the library and a class-mate told me that she  
had obtained a grant to work in the library.

I was on my way home by bus.  A man who had drunk a fair amount of  
alcohol started talking, trying to hug and pat a woman sitting  
next to him.  Fortunately it was not me.

Finding out I am chosen to collect norms for Chinese aphasia (I  
will contribute to China's catching up with the West in  
neuropsychology).

I felt very disgusted at a friend to whom I had given a Psychology  
book to read, and she did not care to give me back the book  
during the exams.

During military service I heard the story of someone who tried to
